title: Independent acceptance of CONFIG-X, COMPAT-X and TENANT-X (and their children) is asserted only in implementer-authored records; no auditor, audit report or operator decision exists in the repo
impact: The three closer stages say 'independently accepted' with exact SHAs, but the only sources are the qualification records and the roadmap (the CONFIG-X record ends with the implementer-report disclaimer). No auditor identity, protocol (03/IIAC), audit report or operator decision resolves in the repo: git grep of the closing SHAs finds only the roadmap, checklist, matrices, replay matrix and the records themselves, unlike EBH-5/EBH-6 which cite named Protocol 03 records. 28 FRZ PASS rows (CFG 8, CMP 8, TEN 12) rest on this; independence cannot be classified.
recommendation: Owner attaches the actual audit records (or an operator ratification of the historical acceptance) per closing SHA, or ROADMAP-REPLAY-X / EBH-7 Protocol 03 explicitly re-accepts the 28 FRZ rows with a named independence basis.

title: COMPAT-X-R2-P0-R2 was accepted with 47 failed / 1633 passed in its targeted run recorded as 'mandatory future debt'; no later disposition exists and the log is untracked
impact: The record states 47 failures (governance identity, tool side-effect safety, agent-distribution architecture gates, integration catalog double registration 'redis', runtime events spine) were 'owned by their respective stages; not remediated or waived'. git grep at the baseline finds the figure only on this line; the cited log is under .tmp/session (not versioned) and the repo has no known-red register (filed separately). Whether the failures were fixed, waived or remain red is not recorded, so the red/green basis of the accepted stage is unknown.
recommendation: Campaign B runs the same targeted selection at the baseline and maps each failure to an owner or fix commit; owner records the disposition.
